ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The protractor with center $O$ and the right-angled triangle $ABC$ are placed as shown in the figure, with the 0-degree line of the protractor coinciding with the hypotenuse $AB$. Point $D$ is a point on the hypotenuse $AB$. A ray $CD$ is drawn intersecting the arc $AB$ at point $E$. If the reading corresponding to point $E$ is $50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BDE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect $OE$,\\
the reading corresponding to point $E$ is $50^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOE=50^\circ$,\\
$\because AB$ is the diameter, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ point $C$ lies on $\odot O$,\\
$\therefore \angle ACE=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOE=\frac{1}{2}\times 50^\circ=25^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BCE=90^\circ-25^\circ=65^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle BDE$ is the exterior angle of $\triangle BDC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BDE=\angle BCE+\angle DBC=65^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{110^\circ}$.

先描述图像：图中 AB 是一条水平线段，也是量角器半圆的直径，O 在 AB 上作为圆心。A 在左端，B 在右端，点 C 在 AB 上方，构成直角三角形 ABC；图中 D 位于 AB 上且在 O 的左侧。射线 CD 向左下方延长，与量角器的下方圆弧交于点 E。E 在左下方圆弧上，对应读数为 50°。

再推理：按照解析几何模型，取 O 为原点，AB 为 x 轴，量角器半径为 1，设 A=(-1,0)，B=(1,0)。由图中的 45-45-90 直角三角形位置，取 C=(0,1)。因为 E 在以 O 为圆心的圆上，并且相对于 OA 的读数为 50°，且 E 位于左下方圆弧，所以 E=(-cos50°, -sin50°)。

直线 CE 的斜率为
m = (-sin50°-1)/(-cos50°-0) = (1+sin50°)/cos50°。
利用恒等式 (1+sin50°)/cos50° = tan(45°+25°)=tan70°，可知直线 CE 与正 x 轴所成的锐角为 70°。

在点 D 处，射线 DB 沿正 x 轴方向，而射线 DE 沿同一直线向左下方，因此 ∠BDE 是正 x 轴与左下方向射线之间的夹角，等于 180°-70°=110°。

raw_record.original_question: The protractor with center $O$ and the right-angled triangle $ABC$ are placed as shown in the figure, with the 0-degree line of the protractor coinciding with the hypotenuse $AB$. Point $D$ is a point on the hypotenuse $AB$. A ray $CD$ is drawn intersecting the arc $AB$ at point $E$. If the reading corresponding to point $E$ is $50^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle BDE$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure, connect $OE$,\\
The reading corresponding to point $E$ is $50^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOE=50^\circ$,\\
$\because AB$ is the diameter, $\angle ACB=90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ point $C$ lies on $\odot O$,\\
$\therefore \angle ACE=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOE=\frac{1}{2}\times 50^\circ=25^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BCE=90^\circ-25^\circ=65^\circ$,\\
$\because \angle BDE$ is the exterior angle of $\triangle BDC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BDE=\angle BCE+\angle DBC=65^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{110^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure there is a protractor arc centered at O, A, O, B are on the same horizontal straight line, and AB is the diameter of the circle; right triangle ABC is placed above AB, C is the right-angle vertex, and AB is the hypotenuse; from the shape of the right isosceles triangular ruler in the figure, ∠ABC=45° can be read. Point D is on AB and is located to the left of O; after straight line C-D continues to be extended, it intersects the lower-left circular arc at E, so C, D, E are collinear, and E is on the circular arc.

Reasoning: Connect OE. The problem says the protractor reading corresponding to E is 50°, and the 0° line coincides with AB, so the central angle ∠AOE=50° can be obtained. Because AB is the diameter of the circle, and ∠ACB=90°, by the converse of the inscribed angle theorem, point C is also on the circle with O as the center and AB as the diameter. Thus A, C, E are all on the same circle, and the arc AE subtended by the inscribed angle ∠ACE corresponds to the central angle ∠AOE, so ∠ACE=1/2×50°=25°. Also because ∠BCA=90°, ∠BCE=90°−25°=65°. In triangle BDC, D, C, E are collinear, so ∠BDE is an exterior angle of triangle BDC, and ∠BDE=∠BCD+∠DBC=65°+45°=110°.
